purpose: Account of Alexey testing an agent-team process across projects

required_facts.fact: The main session acts as an orchestrator.
The four roles are PM, SWE, Tester and On-Call Engineer.
Tasks pass through grooming, implementation, QA and PM acceptance.
Two tasks are commonly run in parallel.
The AI Shipping Labs website had 41 of 46 tasks done overnight.
DataTasks used Lambda and DynamoDB constraints and was paused.
Merm became a published pure Python Mermaid renderer after benchmarking.
Rustkyll compares output with Jekyll and targets faster builds.
Codehive addresses stopping, visibility, skipped process and provider limits.

author_attribution: Attribute projects and outcomes to Alexey and collaborators as named in the source.
